title: Skill-evolution instrument — fixture and report documents
description: The two closed documents `benchmark/trace2skill.ts` reads and writes: the Tangle-authored MIT fixture (tasks, disjoint evolve/test splits, the frozen human skill directory, the scripted wire, the registered patch pool and the oracle expectations) and the keyless report (split identities, run identity, the deepening and creation tables, the analytic oracle, the registered probes, every counted failure and the capability gates derived from rows and probes). TypeScript is generated from this document by `@jarenjs/emit`; the arithmetic an honest report depends on binds here through `$query` at validation time. Every object closes its properties, so credential material or an undeclared member cannot be carried, and no member anywhere holds a clock reading.

relativePath.description: A repository- or fixture-relative POSIX path. No leading slash, no parent segment.

sourceManifest.description: The fixture's effective bytes, path-ordered. Deliberately free of a commit identity: the committed report is a `--check` gate, and a gate that went red because HEAD moved would measure the repository, not the instrument.

condition.description: The skill condition a row measures. `no-skill` runs the executor with no directory; `frozen-s0` uses the human starting directory unchanged; `draft-s0` uses the trajectory-blind draft that creation mode starts from; `evolved-s-star` uses the merged candidate; `retrieval-bank`, `single-call-error` and `sequential-merge` are the named ablations; `cross-model` and `ood` are the transfer tiers, which need a second model or a second domain adapter; `oracle` and `random` are analytic controls that call no model.

rowStatus.description: `run` means every unit of the row executed and its numbers are measurements. `not-run` means the row was planned and deliberately not executed. `implementation-missing` means the mechanism the row measures does not exist yet — an honest skip, never a zero.

taskLabel.description: The evaluator's verdict for one task. `failed` is a unit that produced no answer at all (a missing script entry, a refused tool); `unanswered` is a unit that answered with nothing.

skillRef.description: The directory a row used, or null when it used none. `hash` is the root page digest; `bundleId` is the canonical identity over the ordered file manifest.

rowCounts.description: Every way a unit can fail to become a score, published whether or not it happened. A zero here is a measurement; an absent member would be a hidden failure.

rowDeltas.description: Signed differences against the two baselines of the row's own table, or null when the baseline did not run. A regression is published with its sign, never dropped.

reason.description: Why a row is not `run`, in the instrument's own words. A `run` row carries null.

probe.description: One registered mechanism observation. `expected` is authored with the fixture, before any implementation exists; `observed` is null exactly when the mechanism is missing.

analystRole.description: One analyst role's yield over the evolve split: trajectories read, patches proved, analyses excluded, and what the role spent doing it.

analystsBlock.description: The analyst stage, published beside the tables rather than inside them: analysts read the evolve split while every row scores the held-out one. Both roles are always listed and every exclusion reason carries its count, including the reasons no unit reached, so a run cannot publish only the analyses it liked.

mergeNodeRow.description: One merge group as the report publishes it: where it sat in the tree, how many patches it was given, how many distinct edits it kept, how many proposals it folded away and how many it withheld as conflicting.

consolidationBlock.description: The consolidation stage, published beside the tables: the tree the committed pool was cut into, every decision each group made, and the single application that produced the candidate. Every decision name carries its count, including the ones no group reached, so a run cannot publish only the merges it liked. `withheldHunks` counts what the compiler withheld from the applied patch and is zero by construction, because a merge whose hunks conflict never reaches the committer.

capabilities.description: Derived from rows and probes, never asserted. `complete` is true only when no mechanism row is still an honest skip.

splits.description: The evolve/test division and the refusal counter that guards it. Only the evolve half may influence a directory; an id in both halves is refused and counted, and the instrument capability goes false.

identity.description: Everything a row's number depends on besides the fixture. A run row that cannot name all of it is not a measurement.

randomBand.description: The analytic band a seeded uniform draw over the registered answer pool must land in: the expectation, plus and minus four standard errors and one task of slack.

oracleBlock.description: The scorer proven before a table prints: the analytic ceiling over the held-out split, and the seeded random control with the band it has to land in.

fixtureIssue.description: A refusal the instrument counted instead of throwing: the fixture moved, a split overlaps, a registered file is absent, a compiled patch was withheld, a unit stopped on the run budget. The code range is the whole reserved band, because a run now executes mechanisms that refuse outside the loader's own reasons.

taskDocument.description: One evolution or held-out task. `inputs` names the files the executor may read; ground truth lives elsewhere and never appears here.

truthDocument.description: One registered answer. Read only by the adapter's evaluation and the error analyst's post-failure boundary; any other read is a counted leakage.

patchDocument.description: One registered directory patch and the refusal it is expected to earn. This order registers them; compiling them belongs to the compiler that owns the patch language.

mergeTreeDocument.description: The plan the valid pool is expected to produce: groups of at most `bMerge`, levels until one patch remains, nothing truncated.

labelsDocument.description: The registered verdict of every task under every condition, authored with the corpus. The scripted wire is derived from it, so an answer cannot disagree with the label it is supposed to earn.

ablationPatches.description: What the single-call diagnosis proposes on a trajectory the evaluator-proven role proposed nothing for. Registered rather than derived: an ablation that invented its own proposal would be measuring the fixture author, not the missing evaluator.

oracleDocument.description: What the scorer must reproduce before a table prints: the analytic ceiling, the registered answer pool, the seeded draw and its band, and the held-out score every condition is expected to earn.

scopeDocument.description: What a trajectory-blind draft is allowed to see: the domain, the shape of an answer and the tools an executor will have. It carries no task, no input path and no registered answer, so a directory drafted from it cannot have been fitted to either half of the split.

scriptUnit.description: The logical descriptor a scripted response is keyed by. It deliberately carries no content hash: the wire is fixture-local, while directory identity is bound by the report's `identity` and the fixture's `s0` digests, so a later order can fill a row without renumbering the script.

trace2skillFixture.title: Skill-evolution fixture manifest
trace2skillFixture.description: The registered corpus. Every derived member here is recomputed by `benchmark/scripts/trace2skill-fixture.ts` and refused by the loader when it disagrees with the files on disk.

provenance.description: Authorship of the corpus. Its date describes the fixture and never reaches a report — a report that carried a clock reading would stop being byte-reproducible.

legacyPacks.description: The salvaged retrieval-baseline prompt packs, kept as named fixtures so an ablation row can name exactly what it reproduces. Nothing compiles them into a package; they are the paper's baseline, not its method.

rollouts.description: The failing evolve rollouts an error analyst is registered to reach a patch for, and the one it cannot: a directory edit does not repair an exhausted turn budget.

ablation.description: The salvaged cluster-then-retrieve baseline's registered parameters. They belong to the named ablation row and to no path that evolves a directory.

activationRefusal.description: One activation the instrument attempted and the gate refused, with the clause that stopped it. Published whether or not anybody expected it to fail: a refusal matrix that lists only the refusals it liked proves nothing about the fence.

evaluationBlock.description: The held-out evaluation and the activation that may follow it. Eligibility is computed only from held-out rows and is published beside every clause the gate applies, the per-task regressions, what a second drive of the same run spent, and the five refusals that must not move the head. `activated` can never exceed one: the fence applies a candidate once.

clauses.description: Every gate clause the candidate failed, by the member it names.

regressions.description: Held-out tasks the candidate scores lower on than the directory it replaces.

drives.description: How many times the same run was driven end to end; the second drive is the resume evidence.

candidateStable.description: Whether the resumed drive produced the same candidate identity as the first.

trace2skillReport.title: Skill-evolution report
trace2skillReport.description: What `npm run benchmark:trace2skill` writes. Clock-free and byte-reproducible: two builds over identical fixture bytes render the same document, and `reportId` is the canonical digest of everything else.

tables.description: Deepening starts from the human directory, creation from the trajectory-blind draft. They keep separate denominators because they answer different questions; a row is never carried between them.

envelope.description: The shared config-identity envelope. Every row here is a not-run analytic row: nothing in this instrument runs a provider stack.

ablationCounter.description: One counted fact about an ablation, named where it is published so a number never travels without its meaning.

ablationEntry.description: What one ablation removed from the method, the directory it produced instead, and every counted difference. A row here always has a table row of the same condition beside it.

score.description: The held-out score of this ablation's own table row, or null where it did not run.

vsEvolved.description: Signed held-out delta against the evolved directory. Positive means the ablation beat the method, and is published as it stands.

ablationsBlock.description: The diagnostic half of the report: the method's own consolidation beside every ablation of it, with each ablation's signed held-out delta against the evolved directory. A positive delta is an ablation that beat the method and is published as it stands.
